environment.description: Flask application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. No container runtime, no syscall filtering. The application listens on port 8080 with no reverse proxy or WAF. The SIGUSR1 signal can be sent by any process running as the same user. Network security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 10.0.0.0/8.
